registryCustodian: DRC Ministry of Land Affairs; Kasongo circonscription foncière in Maniema
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery queries were executed. The official ministry directory evidences Kasongo as a Maniema cadastral/land district; the BIC public site advertises digital cadastral data only for North-Kivu and South-Kivu. Full queries, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-6295-kasongo.json.
requestOutcomes: Anonymous GETs retrieved the ministry directory, ministry home, BIC home/current JavaScript, BIC public Supabase view queries, and the official public-service cadastral procedure page. The bounded Maniema and Kasongo name queries returned empty responses; no parcel geometry, schema CRS, or Kasongo feature was obtained. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.

schemaAndCrs.parcelSchema: BIC cadastral_parcels_public safe fields observed: id, parcel_number, parcel_type, province, ville, commune, quartier, territoire, latitude, longitude
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdField: id (service schema only; no Kasongo row returned)

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-4.43176027529522, 26.665145048636] was preserved and not moved to force a parcel hit.
Empty bounded responses were not treated as evidence of citywide absence.
The ministry directory establishes a local custodian, not a verified anonymous citywide parcel-vector feed for Kasongo.
No parcel polygon or source-specific raw attribute set is retained.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: A relevant local cadastral custodian and official BIC lead were evidenced, but no anonymous public Kasongo parcel ID-plus-geometry response, geometry CRS, or citywide open coverage was qualified.

uncertainty: The ministry and BIC may front additional offline or authenticated land-information workflows not exposed in the inspected anonymous pages. This unresolved endpoint is recorded as unavailable evidence, not as proof that Kasongo lacks cadastral parcels.
